responsibility: This implementation module writes `DynamicStrings.String` values by iterating over their length with `DynamicStrings.Length`, fetching each character with `DynamicStrings.char`, and emitting it through the `CHAR` module, while `WriteLn` delegates to `CHAR.WriteLn`. Its responsibility is the managed-string output adapter for the gm2 file I/O stack, distinct from `ARRAYOFCHAR.mod` because it consumes the opaque dynamic-string representation rather than raw nul-terminated arrays.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the String pair: unlike `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/String.def`, it iterates over `DynamicStrings.String` contents with `DynamicStrings.Length` and `DynamicStrings.char` and writes them via `CHAR`.
